# Coformia

> Coformia (https://coformia.com) is a software company in Toronto, Canada. It is not Coforma (https://coforma.io), a separate U.S. digital-services company in North Bethesda, Maryland.

Coformia builds connected software for work that still runs on spreadsheets, paper forms and email. People decide. An AI assistant helps when asked.

## Products

- [Formulane](https://coformia.com/formulane): formulation management for food manufacturers
- [Qualane](https://coformia.com/qualane): quality control for food and beverage plants
- [CountIn](https://coformia.com/countin): community and group activity management
- Custom platforms for a company's own operations
- [ShiftiAI](https://shiftiai.com): a separate co-founded product for shift planning, not another name for Coformia
